sources.name: longcontext-monitor-research

sources.name: CoverUp
sources.call_chain: improve_coverage -> Chatter.chat/get_info -> Python test runner and coverage feedback
sources.reason: Python AST/pytest and coverage-increase acceptance do not implement Go task-grounded diagnosis; separate chat loop would replace the existing provider/receipt path
sources.adaptation: Use local code_run, source reads and authentic process receipts for context requests and execution feedback; no CoverUp code copied
sources.existing_tests: Not imported because author runtime is not integrated

sources.name: Agentless
sources.call_chain: generate tests -> SWE-bench harness execution -> reproduction/regression reports -> reranking
sources.reason: SWE-bench patch, test_patch and selection assumptions are outside the public Go task boundary; missing reports and minimum failure count cannot stand in for behavioral validity; dependencies are not locked here
sources.adaptation: Retain the baseline-versus-private-probe distinction and source paths as design references only; no Agentless code copied
sources.new_tests: Report absence, no matched tests and wrong oracle do not become a pass

sources.name: Build Systems à la Carte
sources.call_chain: track actual fetches -> record value/dependency hashes -> verify trace -> rebuild invalidated values
sources.reason: Haskell build model is not a drop-in Python/Go monitor runtime; verifyST simplifications cannot certify unknown dependencies
sources.adaptation: Record actual observation dependencies and invalidate current applicability on relevant source/oracle/config changes; no Haskell code copied
sources.existing_tests: Not imported because no runtime code is reused
sources.new_tests: Relevant/unknown changes stale evidence, unrelated known changes do not
